'''CV-4T''' was a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] who served the [[GeneTech Syndicate]] on [[Talus/Legends|Talus]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Where are the crash survivors?''"<br />"''They left for Nashal. [...]. The rest of them went in search of the missing crew. I don't know where they are, but I remember the captain making everyone wear tracking emitters. He gave me the password for the tracking device for safe keeping, but I seem to have misplaced the device.|A spacer and CV-4T|<ref name="SWG:TtC" />}}
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], CV-4T was part of the crew of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Narl (captain)|Narl's]] [[Transport/Legends|transport ship]]<ref name="SWG:TtC" /> that belonged to the GeneTech Syndicate.<ref name="SWG:G" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> CV-4T was aboard Captain Narl's ship that transported a cargo of [[Bioengineering/Legends|bioengineered]] [[arachne]]s.<ref name="SWG:RO">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Rescue Operation|Talus}}</ref> Those arachnes were [[bioweapon]]s secretly designed by the GeneTech Syndicate as part of the illegal and dangerous [[Parasophic Arachne]] program.<ref name="SWG:G" /> During the trip, the ship's anti-grav and thruster control broke down and the vessel plowed into the side of a Talusian mountain, northeast of the city of [[Nashal]]. Despite the efforts of Captain Narl, the survivors were not able to eliminate the creatures that broke out of containment and escaped.<ref name="SWG:RO" /> The arachnes quickly molted into more powerful and intelligent creatures and completely overwhelmed the survivors. The ship's crew did their best to protect the scientists and the wounded but the arachne constantly attacked the survivors' camp and took one or two more of them every night. Captain Narl then issued [[Homing beacon/Legends|tracking emitters]] for everyone to wear and gave the tracking device to CV-4T. The survivors established another camp on their road to Nashal while the Captain and some others went in search of the missing crew. Nevertheless, the camp was finally invaded by the creatures and all the survivors were killed. CV-4T was severely damaged in the fight and only his head remained functional.<ref name="SWG:TtC" />

[[File:Arachne_crash_site.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Captain Narl's crashed ship]]
In the meantime, the [[Corellian Security Force]] spotted the crash of Captain Narl's ship. [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Taarna]] dispatched a spacer to investigate the crash site in the mountains and rescue any survivors.<ref name="SWG:RO" /> The spacer visited one of the survivors' camps and found the decapitated CV-4T. The droid was still able to communicate and narrated the awful events that took place earlier. CV-4T also gave access codes to Captain Narl's tracking device. The CorSec spacer thought that the tracking emitters would help to find other survivors. However, the spacer discovered that all other survivors, including Captain Narl, had been killed by the arachnes.<ref name="SWG:GD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Grim Discovery|Talus}}</ref>

The events regarding Narl's ship eventually led to the discovery of the Parasophic Arachne program, which in turn led to a CorSec raid on the [[GeneTech Syndicate Lab]].<ref name="SWG:G" />

==Behind the scenes==
CV-4T appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TtC" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> CV-4T was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Rescue Operation|Genetic Potential]]" arc with the release of "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 2|Chapter 2: The Talus Incident]]," on [[August 1]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 2: The Talus Incident Publish Notes, August 1st">{{SonyForumsCite|full_url=http://soe.lithium.com/swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=58871|text="Chapter 2: The Talus Incident" Publish Notes, August 1st}}</ref>
